def transform(grid):
    freq=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    sep=max(freq, key=freq.get)

    cs=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j]==sep for i in range(len(grid)))]

    bg=max((v for v in freq if v!=sep), key=lambda v:freq[v])

    for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:]):
        row=[]

            vals=[grid[i][j] for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d)]
            row.append(1 if any(x not in (sep,bg) for x in vals) else bg)

    bg=max(freq,key=freq.get)
